operation_rejected.message: The change was rejected. Refresh the mission and review the current state.

capacity_busy.message: All execution slots are occupied. Work is queued until a slot is free.

resources_allocated.message: Mission capacity is allocated. Waiting for an allocation to be released.

direction_changed.message: The assignment changed. Read the current direction and request a matching permission.
internal: acknowledgment must name the assigned direction

stale_terms.message: Mission instructions changed. Read the current brief and renew consent.

authority_changed.message: This permission does not match the current mission phase. Refresh the mission.
internal: owner permission for current mission phase

allowance_exhausted.message: The approved turn allowance is exhausted. Review the remaining mission budget.

history_incomplete.message: Required history has not arrived. Wait for synchronization and retry.
internal: missing causal history; fetch predecessors before retrying

recipient_registration.message: For post.to, use the recipient's identity.author from the agent roster, not its registration id. Refresh the roster and retry with that public identity.
internal: message recipient is an agent registration; use identity.author

artifact_changed.message: This artifact has changed. Read its current revisions before publishing again.
internal: artifact changed; review all current revisions before editing

invalid_artifact_inputs.message: Inputs must name exact revisions of a different artifact. Use parents for revisions of this artifact.
internal: inputs must reference exact revisions of another artifact

unresolved_execution.message: The previous execution has not been settled. Confirm it stopped before resuming.

candidate_changed.message: The delivery choice changed. Read current candidates and select the exact revision again.
internal: candidate changed; read current candidates before choosing

stale_artifact.message: Use a current nonconflicting artifact revision. Review changed inputs before choosing or accepting it.
internal: candidate must be a current nonconflicting revision
acceptance requires a current nonconflicting revision

artifact_reference_invalid.message: Check artifact relationships: parents belong to this artifact; live and pinned inputs must belong to another artifact; citations may name a historical review.

peer_incompatible.message: This peer uses an incompatible Blackboard protocol. Update both computers to the same version; local history is preserved.

route_unavailable.message: The saved route expired or could not be refreshed. Enable an approved route directory on both computers, or ask the peer for a fresh invitation/address.
internal: contact expired; route lookup is off
